m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What did you do to Cyrus to warrant him sending you out for those? If I know him, I'm sure that he wants you to collect wings from --<ITALICS>gasp</ITALICS>-- Death Pixies...
They were the scourge of Unicorn Way before they were banished from Wizard City. The last I heard they were wreaking chaos in Krokotopia.
Try the Library in Krokotopia. Though it was awhile back I'm sure they would have records of the Pixies' escapades.
The Death Pixies, you say? Yes, they did cause some mayhem back in the day. That is, until they were tricked and imprisoned within the Pyramid.
I believe there is a skull obelisk at the excavation site in the Chamber of Fire that mentions these creatures. Take this papyrus and make a rubbing of the glyphs on it.
Yes, Death Pixies were imprisoned in one of the rooms in the Royal Hall. Their chamber is guarded by obelisks that have the sacred scarab on them.
Hmmmm... A door in Royal Hall with two Scarab Obelisks outside. Can't be many of those around. Hope the Pixies are not as bad as everyone says they are...
Can't you see I'm busy striking the palm of my hand with my staff? Away with you..!
Oh, it's you again. And you want me to teach you a spell. How quaint. Luckily, I need some reagents. Find me some Pixie wings.
Only an adept student will be able to locate them. Consult Ivan. He'll know more about them. Now, leave me alone to my studies...
